reviews.name: Victor B.
reviews.quote:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Protech Roof for a roofing project on our family’s rental property, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the experience.

From the very beginning, Julian was professional, knowledgeable, and transparent. At first, the pricing and installment options almost seemed too good to be true. He clearly explained the process, timeline, and financing options, which gave us confidence moving forward.

We were told the installation would take one to two days at most. To our surprise—and delight—the entire roof was completed in just one day. The crew was efficient, organized, and respectful of the property throughout the process.

While Protech was not the cheapest quote we received, they offered by far the best warranty protection. Julian was the only representative who took the time to show us the actual written warranty details. Unlike other companies that advertised a 30-year warranty without proper documentation, Protech provided fully guaranteed labor along with material coverage. For a family rental property, having that level of protection and peace of mind was extremely important to us.

In addition to the roof replacement, they also replaced all of our gutters at a great price—beating many of their competitors. That competitive pricing, combined with the strength of their warranty, truly gave them the edge when we made our final decision.

I also greatly appreciated the flexible monthly payment option, which made the project cost-effective without the burden of paying the full amount upfront.

Overall, Protech delivered exactly what they promised—quality workmanship, strong warranty coverage, efficiency, and excellent customer service. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a reliable and professional roofing company.

reviews.name: Kelsey N.
reviews.quote:
I can’t say enough great things about this roofing company. From the very first phone call, they were professional, responsive, and incredibly helpful. They explained everything clearly, gave me a fair and honest estimate, and showed up exactly when they said they would. The crew worked efficiently, kept everything clean, and treated my home with care and respect.

The quality of the work is outstanding, and the new roof looks amazing. It’s such a relief knowing it was done right. What really stood out was their integrity and communication throughout the entire process—they kept me informed every step of the way.

If you’re looking for a reliable, trustworthy roofing company that delivers excellent results, I highly recommend them. I would absolutely use them again!

reviews.name: Nikia S.
reviews.quote:
I had an outstanding experience working with Josiah. From the very beginning, he demonstrated an impressive level of knowledge, professionalism, and genuine care for making sure every question and concern was addressed thoroughly. Josiah took the time to explain the entire process in a way that was easy to understand. What truly stood out was his diligence and commitment to customer service. He was responsive, respectful, and consistently went above and beyond to ensure everything was handled smoothly from start to finish. It’s rare to come across someone who combines expertise with such a strong sense of integrity and professionalism.

As for Protech Roofing LLC as a whole, the company exceeded expectations in every area. Their pricing was competitive and fair, their warranty options provided peace of mind, and the quality of service was exceptional. The entire experience felt transparent, efficient, and customer-focused. You can tell this is a company that values integrity, stands behind their work, and truly cares about delivering excellent results.

I highly recommend Josiah and Protech Roofing LLC to anyone looking for a reliable, trustworthy, and professional roofing company. They absolutely earned my confidence and future business.

reviews.name: Brett H.
reviews.quote:
We had a full roof replacement done, and I can honestly say this company went above and beyond. They were able to get our new roof installed with no money down, which was a huge relief for us. Even more importantly, they acted quickly and helped prevent what could have turned into major water damage to our home.

The entire crew was professional, efficient, and respectful of our property. They completed the job on time and left everything clean when they finished.

I especially want to recognize Julian, who really stood out during the project. His work ethic, attention to detail, and professionalism did not go unnoticed. You can tell he truly cares about doing the job right.

If you’re looking for a roofing company that moves fast, communicates well, and delivers high-quality work, I highly recommend them.
